numbers.name: systems
numbers.value: 4078 SB9 systems, one orbit each (5099 orbits in the file)

note: PASS under Test Card T032 (approved 27484cf81 before the data were downloaded). 78 percent of SB9 orbits with periods of 1-3 days are circular (e < 0.05), falling monotonically to 18 percent at 100-300 days. Weak test: the period-eccentricity relation was known (SEEN_SUMMARY); circular formation is not separated from tidal settling; authors often fix e = 0 at short periods. Implementation fix made after approval, before the run: the catalogue's orbit-number column is named 'o', not 'Orb' as the draft assumed; the method (lowest orbit number per system) is unchanged. Of the systems counted, n_systems in the output (4078) includes systems outside 1-300 d. L2 approved by the author on 2026-11-25.
